camel_example: aliyun arms ListSyntheticDetail --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy timestamp --Order DESC --SyntheticType 1 --Category SYNTHETIC --EndTime 1684480557772 --PageSize 20 --StartTime 1684110343127 --Page 1 --ExactFilters '[{"Value":"保留字段。","OpType":"保留字段。","Key":"保留字段。"}]' --AdvancedFilters '[{"Value":"1","OpType":"eq","Key":"taskType"}]' --Filters '{"key":"example-string"}' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Detail ICMP_LIST
description_en: Obtains the results of one or more synthetic tests
kebab_example: aliyun arms list-synthetic-detail --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synthetic-type 1 --category SYNTHETIC --detail ICMP_LIST --filters key=example-string --advanced-filters '[{"Value":"1","OpType":"eq","Key":"taskType"}]' --exact-filters '[{"Value":"保留字段。","OpType":"保留字段。","Key":"保留字段。"}]' --start-time 1684110343127 --end-time 1684480557772 --order-by timestamp --order DESC --page 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSyntheticDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the synthetic test. Valid values: 1 and 2. 1 represents an immediate test, and 2 represents a scheduled test
parameters.help_zh: 拨测类型，必填，即时拨测：1，定时拨测：2
parameters.name: synthetic_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the results. Set the value to SYNTHETIC
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The type of the list that contains the results. This parameter is required. Valid values:

ICMP_LIST
TCP_LIST
DNS_LIST
HTTP_LIST
WEBSITE_LIST
DOWNLOAD_LIST
ALL
parameters.help_zh:
拨测结果内容，必填，获取不同类型的拨测结果传不同的值：

PING列表：ICMP_LIST
TCP列表：TCP_LIST
DNS列表：DNS_LIST
HTTP(s)列表：HTTP_LIST
网站测速列表：WEBSITE_LIST
文件下载列表：DOWNLOAD_LIST
拨测结果明细：ALL
parameters.name: detail
filters

fields.help_en:
The filter condition. The taskType and dataId fields are supported.

To query the list of synthetic test results, set the key to taskType.
To query the result details of a synthetic monitoring task, set the key to dataId
fields.help_zh:
筛选条件，支持taskType和dataId字段。

查询拨测结果列表：taskType
查询拨测结果详情：dataId
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The type of the filter condition. Valid values: eq and in. eq: equal to. in: include
fields.help_zh: 筛选类型，支持eq（等于）和in（包含）
fields.name: op_type

fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition. The type of the task. Valid values: 1: ICMP 2: TCP 3: DNS 4: HTTP 5: website speed measurement 6: file download
fields.help_zh:
筛选条件的value。
任务类型：
1：ICMP；
2：TCP；
3：DNS；
4：HTTP；
5：网站测速；
6：文件下载
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
An array of filter conditions. This parameter is required.

To query the list of synthetic test results, set this parameter in the following format: [{"Key":"taskType","OpType":"in","Value":[Task type]}].
To query the result details of a synthetic monitoring task, set this parameter in the following format: [{"Key":"dataId","OpType":"eq","Value":"dataId"}]. dataId is returned when you query the list of synthetic test results
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件数组，必填。

查询拨测结果列表：[{"Key":"taskType","OpType":"in","Value":[任务类型]}]。
查询拨测结果详情：[{"Key":"dataId","OpType":"eq","Value":"dataId"}] ，dataId为查任务拨测结果列表返回值的dataId字段
parameters.name: advanced_filters

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the start time of the query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间的时间戳，必填，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the end time of the query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间的时间戳，必填，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The field based on which results are sorted. Set the value to timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，仅支持：timestamp（拨测发起时间）
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The order in which results are sorted. Valid values:

`ASC`: ascending order
`DESC`: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序标准。取值：

`ASC`：升序。
`DESC`：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size
